js: (async () => { const a = __v2.audio; a.start(); await a.ctx.resume(); const an = a.ctx.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize = 2048; a.master.connect(an); const buf = new Float32Array(2048); const measure = async (ms) => { let peak = 0, sum = 0, n = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < ms) { an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); for (const v of buf) { peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); sum += v * v; n++; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 20)); } return [+peak.toFixed(3), +Math.sqrt(sum / n).toFixed(4)]; }; const out = { state: a.ctx.state }; out.bed = await measure(1200); const p = __v2.game.kitten.char.body.pos.clone(); for (const k of ['meow', 'mew', 'mrrp', 'cry', 'purr', 'hum', 'breath', 'caw', 'horn']) { a.play(k, p, 1); out[k] = await measure(k === 'purr' ? 3500 : k === 'horn' ? 3000 : 1300); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
